731.synopsis:
In the instant that his soul awakened, a new world emerged in front of his eyes. It was a foreign world, a world of Fuzhou. Countless secret realms, countless charming beasts. There were even higher-levelled Fuzhou worlds.
12th Guo was like a pawn crossing the river*. He instantly killed all enemies that obstructed his survival. He needed to constantly get stronger, needed to find even stronger Fuzhous.
When he stood on the peak of the Fuzhou world, could he still continue forward?
* this line is likely a reference to the game of Xiangqi/象棋, where a pawn/soldier, upon crossing the halfway line of the board, known as the river, gains additional abilities.

987.synopsis:
I am the Demon King… or was, in my previous life. Now, I’m a human noble girl known as Rosewood Angelique. My fiance, Heath, has been indifferent to me lately. Just as I was thinking about why this would be, I recovered fragments of my previous life’s memories and the memories of the life before that as well, that had helped me in the previous life.
This is a romance story from my previous world, and I’ve been reincarnated as the noble girl villainess in the story.
associated_names: I, the Demon King, Have Become a Noble Girl Villainess? Hah, What a Joke.
Maou de Atta Yo ga Akuyaku Reijou Dato? Ha Shoushi
魔王であった余が悪役令嬢だと？ハッ笑止。

1243.synopsis: Our socially despondent protagonist decides to have some fun using risky blackmail to methodically transform an innocent daft classmate into his personal s*x s*ave.
associated_names: Bishoujo o Jouzu ni ○○○ ni Suru Houhou
How to Skillfully Make a Beautiful Girl into a Meat Toilet
美少女を上手に○○○にする方法
美少女を上手に肉便器にする方法

1755.synopsis:
In a time and place where one’s soul can be morphed into a weapon, there are modern-day magicians called Mage-Knights. Although Kurogane Ikki is a student at an institution that trains Mage-Knights, he has no particular talent in magic and is labeled the “Failure Knight” or “Worst One.” Getting way less than average marks in the scorings, he was forced to repeat a year. But with the arrival of a new head of the institution, a new rule was created: knights whose abilities are compatible, as decided by the board, must share rooms and attend practice and training together throughout their school years to bring up their abilities to the max. It is a rule to implement the absolute verdict of ability.
Ikki’s roommate, Stella Vermillion, turns out to be a princess of another foreign country. Stella is a Rank A knight: the type of genius in magic who only appears once a decade. When Ikki walked in on her while she was changing her clothes, it caused a huge misunderstanding, which eventually ended up in a duel between the two of them. The punishment for the losing side is Eternal Submission to the winning side.
Forced to live the same room and practice magic together throughout all their school years, how will Stella and Ikki’s relationship evolve?
associated_names: The Heroic Tales of the Failure Knight

4059.synopsis:
Kurei Yukito made a wish on the verge of dying. In his next life, he would like to become someone who can understand other people.
However, the next time Yukito woke up, he had been reincarnated to a different world in the midst of war. Moreover, he was granted a cheat skill as a result of misunderstanding his last wish.
He was picked up by the rebel Prince, worked as the go-between of messengers from other countries and did his best to talk to them despite his poor social skills. Yukito desperately lived in this different world in order to accomplish his dying wish.
Nevertheless.
In this world where wars are common, hints of war gradually crept up to Yukito…
associated_names: 軍師は何でも知っている

5595.synopsis:
Many islands dotted the vast oceans of this world. However, some of the islands were a lot more sinister than the rest. 
Those islands, known as Nightmare Islands, were true nightmares to all but the strongest and most fortunate. Children were kidnapped and thrown on these isolated islands by the Nightmare Palace, forced to sign soul pacts with evil soul pets: Nightmares. These devils slowly devoured the souls of their trainers to grow stronger. If the children did not cultivate fast enough, their souls will be devoured whole, leaving only an empty husk behind.
Chu Mu, the protagonist, was an heir to the Chu Clan, but due to a plotted mu*der, he was thrown on the island, sentencing him to almost certain death. Dancing on the edge of life and death, he struggled to survive with a small Moonlight Fox he captured. When he finally escaped the devilish foremen on his island, he couldn’t help but let a breath out. But little does he know, the experience was only a beginning to a fated journey with his little Moonlight Fox…

6363.synopsis:
A boy that was imprisoned for millions of years has regained a mortal body.
He became a disciple of the declining Cleansing Incense Ancient Sect where its patriarch used to be his disciple. Now he will bring this sect back to its former glory.
This is his journey to reach the apex and take revenge on those who had imprisoned him.
This is his story of meeting old friends and making new companions.
This is his path of traversing the Nine Worlds and becoming the next ruler of the Heavens.
Several millennia have passed and the golden age of experts has passed. A master whose disciples once were the most exalted Immortals among the 9 worlds had all left him. With his mortal body, mortal physique and mortal life wheel… he shall sweep the 9 worlds and take what is rightfully his.

6875.synopsis:
Earl’s son Julius Rosenberg has two secrets.
First is the open secret that, despite being born a woman, he was brought up as a man to succeed the Earldom which lacks an heir.
People called “him” the Beautiful Crossdresser, and were charmed by his dubious, androgynous appeal.
In addition, the second secret is…
The first secret is actually a misunderstanding.

8411.synopsis:
Becoming this world’s strongest person and returning in 30 years.
What is this world? The Earth I returned to is in the Era of Raids!
However, I’m now tired. I’ve retired and I want to live while opening a restaurant.
In the most “ordinary” way.

8923.synopsis:
To Ji Yi, Ji Cheng Yang is the joy in her childhood, a cup of coffee in her teenage years, that kite especially painted just for her, that part of A Chinese Odyssey she never finished, that irreplaceable longing and love in her dull life.
Ji Yi chased after his back, followed in his footsteps, liked the things that he liked.
To Ji Yi, the whole of her youth, from the moment she met Ji Cheng Yang, was carved with only one name.
To Ji Chengyang, Ji Yi is the soft ray of light at dawn, the warmest existence, the care kept deepest in his heart. He has once, for the sake of his dreams, forsaken her, hurt her, but in the end, he returned by her side.
She is the very first of his memories, as well as the Ji Yi he loves the most.

9179.synopsis:
“I can clear all your debts, but you have to substitute me in my marriage…”
When Liang Dou Kou was diagnosed with cancer, she formed a contract with Qin Zhi Ai to substitute her in the time she would be absent, including her marriage with Gu Yu Sheng.
Initially, Qin Zhi Ai suffered under the cold and harsh attitude of Gu Yu Sheng, who mistook her for Liang Dou Kou. But his heart gradually softened and he fell in love with her.
Just when he thought that he could live happily ever after with her, it is time for Qin Zhi Ai and Liang Dou Kou to revert their identities, and Qin Zhi Ai evaporated from Gu Yu Sheng’s life.
Months later, Gu Yu Sheng meets someone who possesses the gaze of Qin Zhi Ai who captured his heart…
associated_names: Ge Qiang You Nan Sheng: Qiang Xing Xiang Ai 100 Tian
The Dream Guy Of My Past
隔墙有男神：强行相爱100天

9435.synopsis:
After the whole class was summoned to another world it was not fantasy that awaited them. What awaited them was a cruel dark fantasy where humanity on the brink of destruction by the outbreak of monsters everywhere. 
What is awaiting the MC in this world?

15067.synopsis:
“Master, the people from the Zhuang family have come to cancel the engagement.”
“My fiancé whose beauty was said to be capable of causing the downfall of a city, finally decided to throw me away?”
“I think so.”
“I want to see this legendary beauty, and confirm whether this bastard is really great as people say, to have no flaws in all 360 degrees, a picturesque appearance however you look at him; does he need me to help him open the corner of his eyes (Epicanthoplasty) or reshape his chin (Genioplasty)?”
“Actually, he didn’t come.”
“He didn’t? He didn’t even come to cancel the engagement? What a wicked b*tch.”
“He definitely will get karma.”
associated_names: After Rebirth, See How an Abandoned Son Turn the Tide!

17371.synopsis:
Number one, perfectionist, ballerina, impulsive, and amazona—that was Alzeah Marie Constantino! She believed that she was beautiful, exceptional, and smart. But beware, because she never backed down. She cursed a lot; she didn’t have friends aside from her lazy, lazy, lazy childhood frenemy and neighbor, Tyrone James Dela Cruz. The only person Zeah had been ever kind to was him, but Tyrone was only ever unkind towards her.
One time, Zeah witnessed how Tyrone’s friend and first love betrayed him. She was livid; she wanted to take revenge for Tyrone by being his tutor and life coach.
Soon, Tyrone might fall for her; or Zeah might even fall for him, despite the fact that she had always prioritized her studies and career. One had to wonder if they were meant to be.
“Once upon a time, there was no happily ever after and happy ending. Once upon a time, there was no once upon a time for life was not a fairy tale.”

18139.synopsis:
After signing the share transfer of the Bai company, Bai Weiwei who had a cong**ital heart disease got betrayed by her adopted sister she always loved along with her trusted bodyguard.
Shocked, betrayed, and worried for her father made her unwilling to die, and her resentment actually let her bind with a quick transmigration system. Completing the task means that she will be able to increase the number of days she can live, and she will be able to get revenge on her white lotus sister and the unconscionable bastard bodyguard.
CEO, Emperor, General… Supreme Immortal? All of them will turn to a love-sick waste who bowed before her skirt.
Just… why is this unlucky star of a wooden fiancee trying so hard to chase her? Stop sucking my life force already! Our marriage is only for business! I want to break the engagement!
Ye Yuxuan: “I will never let go of you.”
Bai Weiwei: “…………..”

21211.synopsis:
The Imperial Court of Tang Empire became dim and corrupt. The Emperor believed eunuchs. The officials vied with each other for authority. The Tang Empire was about to collapse. The flouring Confucianism, Buddhism and Taoism eyed it covetously. The three sects wanted to contend for the domination of the whole world. Which one would win in the end? Or would they coexist peacefully at last? Armies of different nations invaded the frontier on all sides. People and the whole world were in extreme misery. Who could save them?
A young man of the Imperial Clan was reborn in Chang’an. In the Last Life, he was framed and was driven out of his place. He was the king of the subjugated country. When he wandered on the streets, he wanted to be an ordinary people and live an ordinary life in Chang’an but failed.
In this life, he determined to fight against the heaven and change his own fate. He would not give those people an opportunity who framed him in his Last Life. He would hold his title and his place. In order to maintain order and peace of the world, he was going to wipe out all villains of the whole world with the Imperial Sword, adhere to the emperor’s principle, and enact the new national law. He would rule over the empire to prove himself.

27867.synopsis:
Myohan, a very normal and boring student, has a secret that he cannot tell anyone. He can turn into a cat!
But one day, that ‘man’ appeared out of nowhere and tells him how to cure this! He must find others who can also turn into animals. There are 12 out there who turn into each of the animals of the zodiac!
But as he finds them one by one, he starts to remember the things he had forgotten about one by one…

28379.synopsis:
Su An has been struggling in the last days for more than a decade, and a death as a hero after taking down the Zombie Emperor is quite good, thus Su An intends to close his eyes and rest in peace.
Rest in peace, my ass!
Opening his eyes again, Su An found himself back before the apocalypse, and turned into a weak, cry baby pretty boy, the type with no skills or whatsoever other than the face.
Su An just wants to smile!
Its good to be a pretty boy. Its wonderful to be a pretty boy. Pretty boys can frankly be a salted fish who can only eat and drink!
And then, Su An discovered that the world he found himself in is not strictly pre-apocalyptic, but it was also going through the last days.
– – all living resources can only be obtained as a drop in a game with an apocalyptic setting.
Su An looked at the game in front of him that needs mandatory participation of the whole population. With a face full of awe, he entered… and learned that the game has zombies.
– – It’s you again! [Death Ray.jpg]
And then… – –
#NewbieReachedTheTopInOneNight#
#TheManWhoTerrifiesTheDead#
associated_names: 从末世回来后我变成了小白脸

29403.synopsis:
Every profound love story must have a cannon fodder ex-girlfriend. If one day the ex-girlfriend blackens… aah, that would be fun! 
Blackened quote: Don’t be so quick to say like, I won’t be able to stop myself from hiding you away in the cabinet. Either you die, or I laugh as I watch you die. You thought you fell for an angel all on your own, therefore you deserve to be used by me.

30171.synopsis:
Nara Lee, an ambitious and diligent 35 year old, has finally achieved her dream: buying a rooftop apartment! Little did she know she wouldn’t have time to enjoy it, as she ends up reincarnated as the 8-year-old Sharon Atrina, a side character in her favorite webnovel, “The Queen’s Extravagant Outing.” As Sharon, a wealthy and beautiful noblewoman, she has everything she could possibly want, but she’s destined to die a pitiful death at the age of 20 after being betrayed by her best friend, Carol — the villainess!
Rather than waiting for death, she takes it upon herself to raise Carol — whose terrible personality resulted from bad parenting — into a better person, and save both of their lives to change their future!
associated_names: The Kids Have Changed (Official Tapas Manhwa) (Completed)

30939.synopsis:
In the world of fiction, Ariel finds herself mysteriously transported into the pages of an adult novel she had kept hidden, assuming the role of the tormented female protagonist who had suffered at the hands of the male lead.
But Ariel refuses to accept her fate and decides to rewrite her own story. Determined to break free from the male lead’s control, she resolutely declares, “Your body belongs to me,” as she confronts the charismatic antagonist.
As Ariel embarks on her quest to reshape her destiny, she is willing to embrace the reputation of a merciless and captivating saint if it means seizing control of her own narrative.

33243.synopsis:
Orphaned at a young age, Layla Llewellyn feels the luckiest girl in the world when she moves in with her uncle Bill, a gardener who lives on the scenic Arvis estate in the Berg Empire.
To Layla, Arvis seems like paradise; she loves exploring the vast forest, always with her notebook to record the wildlife she encounters.
She especially loves the birds, watching them with awe as they hatch and grow from fluffy chicks into beautiful birds.
Duke Herhardt, the young, handsome lord of Arvis, is also interested in birds―and in Layla.
But the difference is that he’s interested in birds because he likes to hunt them… and in Layla because he likes to make her cry. 
If a lovely bird is trapped in a golden cage, which will she choose: a life of luxury or freedom?
……………………………………………………………………. 
NOTE: Read the official translation called “Cry or better yet beg” and not the fan translations as it is complete fan fiction with added lines and mistranslations in every single line.

34011.synopsis:
Lawrence Devitch, a young banker who dominated the Kosimo Empire.
One day, Rahee, a mixed-race girl thrown at him instead of debt.
“Please accept me as a maid .”
It was just a collateral. But…….
The girl is a lady, it began to occur a crack on his frozen heart .
“The contract should have been prudent. It was what you wanted in the first place. So don’t blame me. What I see is not money, but you.”
“You want me to pay off your debts, right?”
“Yes. I want to pay you back. But I have to pay it my way, not your way. That’s right.”
To hold her, he did not hesitate to use any tricks.
Dare! Do not allow her to escape.

34267.synopsis:
Takano Shiori was on a honeymoon with her boyfriend.
If you were summoned as a [Saint] during such a sweet time, of course you’ll be pissed.
What are you doing? Please return me.
associated_names: Seijo Shoukan Saremashita kedo, Kareshi ga Iru node Kaerimasu
聖女召喚されましたけど、彼氏がいるので帰ります

35291.synopsis:
How does an unmarried woman suddenly have an abundance of offspring everywhere? Female lead Dan Jingqiu suddenly dies from a heart attack. Her soul was taken away by ‘The Good Mother System’, 008, and brought into the world of novels. Aiming to fulfill the final wishes of mother characters and to release their souls from their regretful attachments to their respective world, The female lead travels through different novels to save various children from their pain and misfortune. In the process, she undergoes personal growth and change, Ultimately becoming the admirable good mother of her wards.
This novel is a series of short stories with quick plot developments. It delves into the complex relationships between a mother and her children involving love, conflict, and contradictions. Using empathy and love, the female lead changes various worlds’ original storyline and ultimately prevents the bad endings of her children. Although the settings are all in the novel world, the solutions were practical and easily relatable.

36827.synopsis:
Right in front of the prince, who had come to take her away with the glass slipper in hand, Cinderella elopes with the wizard! The prince, who couldn’t leave empty handed lest he become a laughingstock, decided to take Cinderella’s not mean stepsister with him instead. They returned to the castle, got married, and lived happily ever after…Not!
You’re not going to love me? Of course, I know that. I’m just aiming for a peaceful divorce with tons of alimony. Feel free to get a mistress or concubine in the meantime.
The new princess enjoys her peaceful palace life, managing her field and fishing, but for some reason, the prince’s cold attitude begins to thaw…?
This is the story of Cinderella’s older stepsister, whose feet won’t fit the glass slipper and who doesn’t have a pumpkin carriage, reluctantly marrying the prince, while trying to find her own happiness.
*This story is the serialized version of the one-shot with the same name.
associated_names: シンデレラの姉ですが、不本意ながら王子と結婚することになりました～身代わり王太子妃は離宮でスローライフを満喫する～

37595.synopsis:
Reincarnation with a System. These two ought to produce a good result when put together. But he became a girl, and the System was locked to her original self. If she wants to change her tragic past life, she had to find her old self and raise him?
“Well, fine. Nobody understands me more than myself anyway.”
It should haven been a simple task, but…
She gradually began to realize she had led him down the wrong path.
associated_names: 重生成妹后的最强玩家养成

37851.synopsis:
I suspect that I’m crazy.
Crazy. Insane. Mad. However you want to put it. And I mean the type where there’s really something wrong with me, something uncontrollable and life-ruining and in my brain, in my blood, and not just that I’m a little weird or have an overdramatic, rash personality. I suspect I have schizophrenia, OCD, depression and other mental illnesses. 
But there’s a gangster stutterbug that won’t even take mercy on a crazy person, oh my god. Where are his morals?
–—-
Ever since I first met Xue Yaozu at the karaoke parlour where I work part-time, I started seeing him all the time. This self-proclaimed ‘old classmate’ definitely has some hidden, nefarious motive up his sleeves!
Why else would he ask about my job, where I live, and even if he can help me??? Not to mention the fact that he keeps trying to assure me that he’s not a bad guy! Sus! So sus!!!! Red alarms blaring type of sus!!

43227.synopsis:
Lin Xiaocha was a veteran ‘green tea’; she knew her way around playing with love. She could pretend to be cute and innocent, tearing up her opponents, and raised bountiful fish in her green tea fish pond.
She was selected by the system to fulfill the wish of the heroine of an abusive novel, to target the hero and the supporting male characters who were obsessed with the white lotus. And if she were to complete the missions, she would receive generous rewards.
Initially she thought this would be a breeze, her riches were right in her grasp. However, just when the task was about to be accomplished…
She found that she…
Targeted! The! Wrong! Person!
…
Lin Xiaocha: Don’t panic, I’ll do it again. It’s not a big deal.
Until–
Lin Xiaocha: “Xianjun, why lock up Xiaocha?!”
The cold and pure max-level boss: “Didn’t you say you would stay with me forever, that we would be inseparable in life or death?”
He kissed Lin Xiaocha’s earlobe. “This lord is very sure.”
associated_names: 资深绿茶穿成虐文女主

46299.synopsis:
I thought I was the heroine, but I wasn’t. I knew it as soon as I saw my cute little sister that I’ve never met before. She’s the heroine. My shiny younger sister was the heroine everyone loved, and I was just an accidental bonus. 
The woman will love the man, and the man will also love the woman.
But I’m not my younger sister, so why do I keep getting tangled up with the male lead? Meeting him was the worst. The problem is, I’m starting to fall in love with him. He loves my sister, and the whole story will go the way it was supposed to.
“Let’s stop now. Let’s put everything down and disappear.”
I ran away from the climax where he said he would marry my sister. There’s no need to have extras under a flashy spotlight. So I packed up and ran away…
Why is this man here? There was madness in his eyes while looking at me.
“Did you hate me so much?”
“What?”
“This is where you trampled after my proposal and ran away immediately.”
Bloody eyes, tears? Is he crying?
“Wait a minute. A proposal? What are you talking about?”
“It’s no use running away again. I’ll follow you wherever you go.”
The blazing eyes were unfamiliar.
“I’m the only one who’ll see it.”
What did you just say?
“I’ll make it as if you couldn’t breathe without me.”
“What do you mean by that?”
“That day. You didn’t answer me.”
Aha. Got it. I don’t know why, but my sister must have divorced him. Otherwise, The Duke, who hated me, told me that…
“Let’s get married.”
You wouldn’t propose, would you?
associated_names: The Fabulous Lives of the Hillington Sisters (Official Pocketcomics Manhwa)
脇役令嬢とヒロインの妹

49115.synopsis:
In the springtime, when a child reaches adulthood at age of 15, they undergo a ceremony at a temple to receive their skills.
Zesh is born into a noble family whose influence is slowly waning. He is discovered to have multiple skills, a rarity in the world, but he is kicked out of his home when he fails to receive the combat skills his family craves.
The skill he has acquired, the Master Key, is a skill that allows him to fit his key into any keyhole…!
associated_names: スキル：親鍵(マスターキー)で成り上がる　(短編)

49371.synopsis:
When someone says, “I’ll give you a cheat ability, so just use it”, don’t you feel like not using it?
There is nothing more expensive than free stuff.
It’s not cool to get excited about something you got for free.
In a sense, the protagonist is a reincarnation target, but he perseveres while messing with God’s plans.
God makes a mistake in choosing his reincarnation target, and later learns of it.
He later realizes that it’s not like everyone wants to be strong and not everyone wants to make a harem.
And that he has chosen someone who is more attentive than others and is a real pain in the ass…
associated_names: Tenseishita kedo Cheat Nouryoku wo Tsukawanaide Ikite Miru
転生したけどチート能力を使わないで生きてみる

50651.synopsis:
Xiao Yuan bears a heavy responsibility. Because of certain restrictions, he has to get along with a group of s*um people. When the mission was completed, the restrictions disappeared, and Xiao Yuan screamed in delight: Ah, this is the taste of freedom! The Demon Lord who treated him as a plaything and infected him with a Gu worm, the junior brother who disliked him, the young Pavilion Master who used his blood to save his own Senior Brother – forgive him for not accompanying them.
Later, Xiao Yuan learned the “face changing technique” and could imitate anyone’s appearance. With this, he starts various businesses: he can become what the clients wanted as long as he got paid enough. The business of Xiao Yuan’s was booming. He earned a lot of money, and big shots from all walks of life came to him admiringly. Then…
Junior Brother: Oh, I will never let Senior Brother leave me again!
Pavilion Master: Xiao Yuan, do you want me to take out my heart to show it to you?!
Demon Lord: What do I need to do for baby to forgive me, how about I let you bully me back?
Wife chasing crematorium burning all over the world, Xiao Yuan smiles: Don’t ask, asking means you’ve never loved before.

55515.synopsis:
Liang Muqiu seriously doubted if he had read the astrology forecast when he went out today.
He borrowed a fire in the bar, but borrowed it from his ex-boyfriend.
It is said that old partners would never contact each other. However, they hadn’t seen each other for seven years, yet this bastard was not only not old, but also more handsome than before.
Especially when Cen Nan lit a cigarette for him in the dim light, his eyelashes drooped slightly, like when he kissed him under the blossoming tree seven years ago.
Liang Muqiu: Damn it, why was he still a little excited?
It took a long time for Liang Muqiu to wake up.
From the moment he saw Cen Nan, what he wanted to borrow was not fire, but a kiss of reunion after a long separation.
After seven years of separation, he still loved the same person.
Coincidentally, so did Cen Nan.

56283.synopsis:
In spring, a beautiful and elegant girl, who for some reason adores me, who doesn’t stand out, became a junior in college.
It was spring on the campus of a university.
At the welcome party for the new students of the “Cultural Festival Executive Committee” was the lovely and beautiful Kimioka Misono, who caught the attention of everyone there.
Well, even though I am a senior in the same circle, it would have nothing to do with me, who doesn’t stand out.
“Senpai. If you don’t mind, I’d like to sit down next to you.”
“Can I talk to you again?”
“May I join you on the way home?”
And yet, Misono came to me, a simple man, and adored me.
After that, I was invited to her new place,
was treated to delicious home-cooked meals,
finally, she even gave me a key to her apartment.
Misono’s proactive attitude melted my passive heart—
The relationship between a senior and a junior changes into something more.
A slightly mature “intra-circle” romance novel.
associated_names: Sākuru de ichiban kawaii daigaku no kōhai
サークルで一番可愛い大学の後輩

57051.synopsis:
The three most basic human’s desire are hunger, sleeping and s*xual desire. I was transferred into another world and for that reason, it was only a matter of course that I lost those three things. Everything I ate tasted so bad to the point I felt nauseous. When I went to sleep, I had a nightmare and jolted me awake. As for my son, my son didn’t react to anything, not even a twitch.
In order to break free from this predicament, I quit my current job as a knight and went on a journey.
Why did I come to this world? Why did I become like this? I went on a journey in order to find the answer to these questions….
……… And yet, why did the yandere knight captain come following me?!
associated_names: 最強チート能力持ち異世界転移者である僕が騎士団を辞めて、旅に出ようとしたら異世界最強のヤンデレ騎士団長がついてくるせいで女の子にうつつを抜かせない件

57307.synopsis:
Seon Jae-chan, the intelligence service’s ‘snake,’ a human amplifier and success-oriented human specimen, was a guide known for his evil acts committed in the name of unrequited love for Esper Go Woo-jin.
When faced with death, he sincerely repents the past and wishes for Woo-jin happiness. Perhaps it was because of this that Jae-chan woke up again 6 years ago…
The person I wished to lean on and rely on was such a young person.
Woo-jin was much younger and more beautiful than he remembered. Jae-chan made a new plan, this time to become someone who helps Woo-jin and other important people.
[SUCCESS PROJECT] 
Jae-chan has succeeded in all projects except for his love for Woojin.
Will he be able to complete this project successfully as well?

57563.synopsis:
After being transported to another world, I learned the skill ‘Walking’.
On the surface, its effect is (User won’t get tired no matter how much they walk), but a hidden line says (Get one experience point with each step).
The ones who summoned me know nothing about this, and revere the ones who were summoned with me as heroes after seeing their famous skills. I was chased away for being a nuisance with a useless skill.
But that was where my carefree journey through this new world began.

57819.synopsis:
Unique skill [Magic Arrow]. Or rather, a modern dungeon where bows that use arrows are unfavorable.
Amamiya Kaede, who was supposed to be a winner using such a magic bow and having a unique skill, can no longer keep up with his party because of all the disadvantages, and is exploring E-rank dungeons solo.

70107.synopsis:

The group’s favorite looked at the daily drama and helplessly held her forehead: ”She just wants to grow more ‘space’ to live a long life…… She didn’t want to be popular.”

71131.synopsis:
Zhong Yi encountered a young boy eating his meal in the bathroom. This young boy was the other male lead in the new movie he was about to shoot. 72411.synopsis:
The Pink Rabbits are a mysterious clan with the gift of foresight. One day, while living peacefully in the wilderness, they are kidnapped by the Golden Lion Clan. Ruby, who discovers the gruesome scene too late, sets out to find the Black Wolf Tribe to rescue her people.
* * *
Ivan, the leader of the Black Wolf Tribe, harbors one secret that he keeps from the entire tribe.
“Damn!”
Once again, he was fleeing into the mountains to escape the torment that haunted him every night. In his panic and unable to see anything, he stepped on something soft and squishy.
“Ouch!”
For a moment, he lost his balance, but thanks to his agility and quickness, he managed to land unharmed, only to be caught by his tormentors.
“Get lost, don’t come near me!”
Just as he was about to be forced to climax in this embarrassing situation that he didn’t want to show anyone, he saw something with red eyes crawling quickly towards him.
“What the hell!”
Horrified at the sight of the scattered hair and the ruby red eyes, Ivan tried to back away, but was blocked by a tree.
Thump.
“Are you insane? Let go!”
While Ivan froze in shock, Ruby, with sparkling eyes, shouted energetically while looking at the carrot.
“Delicious carrots, I’ll eat them!”
Nom–
“Aaah!”

72923.synopsis:
Ruan Ying, due to a brief “blindness” incident, was admitted to the hospital. After entering the hospital, what she heard most was the patients’ longing for Dr. Lu Yuan.
Gentle and meticulous, refined and restrained. Every aspect of him made people yearn to catch a glimpse of his charm. Ruan Ying was no exception; she was full of curiosity about him.
One day, Dr. Lu Yuan conducted an examination for her in place of a colleague. His fingers were warm, partly covering her eyes, and he whispered, “Relax and slowly open your eyes.”
“Can you see? Look into my eyes.”
Ruan Ying’s ears twitched as she fell into the soothing and melodious sound of his voice.
Her eyelashes fluttered, and her vision became clear. Why did no one tell her that Dr. Lu, with such a pleasant voice, could easily rival a big star in appearance as well?
Dr. Lu Yuan is a doctor in the First Hospital’s Ophthalmology Department. Due to his outstanding looks, he attracts many patients. However, he is devoted to his work and keeps a certain distance from women.
During a gathering, colleagues hopped into Dr. Lu Yuan’s car. To lighten the mood inside the car, a colleague casually turned on the car stereo. Before they could select a station, a soft and gentle female voice came from the speakers.
“Dr. Lu, when are you going home today?”
“Do you miss me as much as you did yesterday? If you do, please call. If not, I’ll be in the study tonight.”
Colleagues: “!!!”
Dr. Lu, we never knew you were like this!

76507.synopsis:
Yu Lan transmigrated into a novel, becoming the real young master in a urban fiction where true and false identities are intertwined. Normally, the real young master, after being found by his family, should enjoy a splendid life different from before.
However, the protagonist of this novel is the false young master, and Yu Lan is merely a gloomy, malicious cannon fodder despised by everyone, destined to never rise to prominence.
Not long after being brought back by his family, he was once again “invited” to leave:
– He was to replace the false young master in a marriage alliance, marrying the major antagonist Chu Wang, who had caused panic in the entire City A and became a vegetative after a car accident.
Fortunately, according to the subsequent plot in the book, Chu Wang would wake up three months later.
Yu Lan: This is easy. I’ll just build a good relationship with the major antagonist during these three months.
But how to build a good relationship with a vegetative became a problem.
One night, as Yu Lan was contemplating strategies to win over the major antagonist lying on the bed, he suddenly heard someone say by his ear, “You’re pressing on my leg.”
He looked at the antagonist lying beside him and then at Chu Wang floating above, calmly observing him, “!!!”
The book didn’t mention that the major antagonist had a spirit behind him while in a coma!?
From then on, Chu Wang became Yu Lan’s figurative military advisor, pointing wherever he wanted, and everyone said he was using a chicken feather as an arrow, waiting to see his misfortune. The entire City A was eagerly anticipating the show.
At a banquet, Chu Wang pointed at his former fiancé who had abandoned him not far away, “Splash wine on him.”
Yu Lan: “Is it okay? Has he offended you?”
Chu Wang remained calm, “He offended you.”
“…”
–
Three months later, the dreaded major antagonist unexpectedly woke up. The entire City A couldn’t wait to witness the drama unfold, but instead of a show, they received wedding invitations:
“I heard that during my coma, everyone took good care of my wife. Thank you all for your hard work.”
People who received the invitations: ??? Clearly, it was your wife who was taking care of us everywhere?!
That night, Yu Lan blushed with intermittent speech, “Now that you’ve awakened, we can… um…”
Chu Wang: “Didn’t you say it yourself? Now we can ‘build a good relationship.’”
Yu Lan: He didn’t mean this kind of relationship back then!

78043.synopsis:
My older sister, who left home to become the bride of the monstrous fallen prince, returned dead. And then:

I became the next princess consort.
Yuan had no intention of ever yielding to the monstrous fallen prince’s cold reception. No matter how long she waited outside, she would never return to that dreadful house.
“If you don’t want to go back, then die. But not in front of my house.”
Until then, Claude didn’t know that his ninth wife would be there for three whole days.
“What if we consummate the marriage?”
The butler, Gustav, who was about to turn away, paused for a moment.
“If we consummate the marriage, even if His Highness wants to drive me away, he won’t be able to, right?”
The butler looked at her with wide eyes, as if wondering how she could think of such a thing. Yuan had no plans to ever leave this comfortable mansion. No matter what it took.

80091.synopsis:
Cat A: “Zhu Yan, do you know how kittens meow?”

Mermaid O: “…”
*
Shu Tang woke up one day to find the world gone mad; humanity was no longer content with just male and female, creating six ABO genders instead.
Shu Tang felt she might be one of the common betas, making up 80% of the population—non-aggressive, not too sensitive, quite peace-loving, and without anything extra to her person, just an utterly ordinary beta.
Then, on her adulthood test: Supreme Alpha!
Shu Tang: ?
Shu Tang’s spirit is a cat. Supported by her SSS-tier spirit, she not only interned at the federal secret sanatorium but also got matched with a fragile omega.
When visiting her delicate fiancé, she mistook 10 for 01 and entered Restricted Area No. 1.
In the Restricted Area lives “Patient No. 1”.
An unbeaten legend, the grand leader of the federation, known as the pioneer of human nuclear weapons.
This leader is an omega, with a merman as his spirit—no secret there.
However, due to his monstrous combat abilities, the discussions usually aren’t about whether he’s omega, but whether he’s human at all.
After a psychic outburst, he became a “monster.”
Wherever he resided turned into the Restricted Area.
Those who trespassed met grim fates.
Shu Tang entered the Restricted Area.

She saw her fiancé’s terrifying, silent figure in the dark.
Shu Tang noted: He must be shy.
She saw her fiancé’s fishtail in the sea, water dripping down, his complexion pale and eyes pitch black.
Shu Tang noted: Low blood sugar.
She found her fiancé’s voice hoarse, never speaking, only emitting beast-like, raspy threatening sounds from his throat.
Shu Tang noted: Quiet by nature, not talkative.
Shu Tang managed to get out.
An alpha asked: Did you see any terrifying beings?
Shu Tang: “Are you talking about the blue rose?”
Other alphas: ?
Blue rose? Who?
Cat, blushing: “He’s nice, just not very healthy.”
Other alphas: ?
Why would she be blushing?
Later, everyone thought Cat A was the one who most relied on the grand leader.
But they didn’t know—
To him, Cat was the blue rose, his spiritual support, his lifeline, his entire conception of living.
She was the one he clung to as he withered.
And in her presence, he grew silently.

82651.synopsis:
Iris is known as the “Icy Lady.”
Born as the only daughter of a certain marquess family, she became the wife of Duke Matthew of the Krum Duchy a few years ago and has never once smiled. Given this, it’s no surprise that she hasn’t been able to build a proper marital relationship. Not only did she never share a bedroom with her husband, but they never talked, and started to not even see each other as time passed. One day, Iris noticed something unusual about her health. She began experiencing occasional, excruciating pains in her chest.
“It’s ‘Frozen Heart Syndrome,'” the doctor declared.
The doctor called in an incurable disease. A curse from a witch of ice said to have lived in a distant northern country.
Those afflicted with this disease have their hearts slowly freeze over. And within about a year from the onset, they inevitably die.
A few days after receiving this diagnosis, her husband, Matthew, informed her of their divorce.
“Since I’ve contracted an incurable disease, this is perfect timing,” Iris said, leaving behind only those words as she departed from the ducal household.

89051.synopsis:
The protagonist, who had been at the bottom of the adventurer rankings for years, had a gift known as ‘Monster Devourer’ This ability merely allowed him to eat monster meat without getting sick, making it seem like a useless power. Naturally, he had no combat abilities.
However, he continued as an adventurer with the promise he had made to his childhood friend, who had started adventuring with him. She had vowed to aim for the top of the adventurer rankings together, and now she was ranked ninth. There was a significant difference between her and the protagonist, who was still at the bottom.
One day, the protagonist faced a turning point. He was attacked by a wolf monster and was on the brink of death. In a desperate frenzy, he bit into the wolf’s flesh.
‘Acquired Skill: Forest Wolf’s Great Fang.’
At that moment, a voice echoed in his mind.
The ‘Monster Devourer’ gift, which he had thought was a failure, turned out to be an all-powerful ability that allowed him to gain the powers of the monsters he devoured while still alive.
Awakened, the protagonist began devouring monsters one after another, increasing his abilities. He rose from the lowest rank and climbed the rankings to reach the top!
The boy, now imbued with the power of a hundred monsters, aimed to catch up with his childhood friend and stand shoulder to shoulder with her by reaching the top of the adventurer rankings.
Watch as the protagonist’s growth, increasingly resembling a chimera, unfolds!
associated_names: Mamono Gurai: Ranking Saikai no Boukensha wa Mamono no Chikara de Saikyou e

89307.synopsis:
A woman who died from an incurable disease was reincarnated in a magical world.
A magical world.
In this world, 70% of the population were magicians. Magicians would create their own magic, imbued with their wishes, and grow along with the magic they created.
Yoo Eunha, the reincarnated woman, was completely captivated by the mysterious charm of magic, something she had only seen in comics or novels in her previous life. To top it off, Yoo Eunha was an extraordinary genius, capable of creating magic at the age of five!
However, the world was vast, and Eunha was not the only genius.
“You… are peculiar.”
The first friend she met through her parents’ connection.
“Don’t look down on me!”
“Hmph.”
“Huh? What’s going on? You shouldn’t fight!”
The friends she made at school.
“Do you think magic is a game?”
And… a connection from her past life.
Yoo Eunha grew while being intertwined with many people and amidst various incidents and accidents. She laughed, cried, got angry, and chatted; at times, it was difficult and exhausting, but when she looked back, she could describe those days as happy.
However, this world was far from a peaceful one.

89819.synopsis:
It had been roughly ten years since Sihyun found himself trapped in a martial arts game. He knew that once he completed the final quest, he would finally return to reality. Yet, the thought of that reward no longer brought him joy. However, the system, in its cruel way, gave him no time to say a proper goodbye to the precious child he had grown to cherish. Without mercy, it forcibly sent Sihyun back to reality.
Sihyun reassured himself that the child would be fine without him, and so he returned to the real world. But something felt off—everything had strangely changed during his absence. Sihyun found himself in utter confusion.
“No way… Has it been three years? And what is this? A gate?”
After enduring the hardships in the game world for ten years and leaving Taewoon behind, how could the world have ended up like this? But that wasn’t the worst of it.
“Master, I’ve missed you.”
His disciple, a character who should have existed only in the game, stood before him, as real as ever. And not just a little different, but vastly changed.
***
Without hesitation, Sihyun ran toward Taewoon, pulling him into a tight embrace. His lips trembled as he bit down hard to keep himself steady. Taewoon, in turn, lifted the hands that had been hanging loosely at his sides, wrapped his strong arms around Sihyun, and buried his face in his master’s neck.
Finally, he had him back.
“Taewoon! Is it really you? How is this even possible?!”
“Master, I don’t know either. When I came to my senses, I was all alone….”
Sihyun’s eyes, now red and puffy, filled with shadowed sorrow as he gently wiped his tear-streaked face. How long had Taewoon been by himself?
“Master… I missed you so much…. Why did you leave me? If I did something wrong, please forgive me. Please… don’t abandon me.”
The soft, hoarse voice struck Sihyun’s heart with an unbearable clarity, cutting into him like a sharp blade. His heart ached, a deep, searing pain that he could hardly bear. He couldn’t bring himself to meet Taewoon’s gaze and hung his head low.
Taewoon’s expression barely changed, but his eyes brimmed with dark, unidentifiable emotions and agony. Slowly, tears began to roll down his cheeks, one after the other.
“No, don’t cry, Taewoon. I— I didn’t leave you because I wanted to! Haa… I’m so sorry. I truly am.”
“…Then, you won’t leave me again, will you?”
“Of course not!”
Guilt surged through Sihyun like a tidal wave, each wave piling on top of the last. He vowed then and there, tightening his fist, that he would protect Taewoon to the very end.
associated_names: After 10 Years, I Return to Find Out I’m a Hunter.

91355.synopsis:
Ning Guiqu transmigrated into a novel, becoming a minor villain with the same name as his real-world self. Fortunately, his character hadn’t appeared in the story yet, as his plot arc wasn’t due to begin for another four years.
Life after transmigration was full of frustrations, so Ning Guiqu created an alternate account to serve as his personal venting space. Whenever he needed to rant, he would message this account. After venting, he would feel much better. This became Ning Guiqu’s way of relieving stress in his new world.
**
When his dormmates invited him to play games, Lu Yuan logged into his WeChat account, which he hadn’t used since graduating high school.
To his surprise, he found 99+ unread messages.
The sender was… his gentle and attractive roommate, Ning Guiqu.
Puzzled, Lu Yuan opened the chat:
[Damn it! Who bumped into my suitcase? Can’t you watch where you’re going?] 
[Having to wake up early for college sucks. Can someone please blow up the school?] 
[Idiot Shi Wen, can you please stop asking me to play games? Don’t you realize how terrible you are?] 
[So what if I’m good-looking? I’m still just an ordinary guy. I don’t want to attend those s*upid mixers! Can’t you leave me alone?] 
…
Lu Yuan froze upon reading the messages.
Beside him, Ning Guiqu asked softly, “Lu Yuan, are you joining us?”
Lu Yuan replied, “In a moment.”
His WeChat pinged again with a message from Ning Guiqu: [s*upid Lu Yuan, hurry up and get online. Think you can keep us waiting just because you’re handsome?] 
Lu Yuan: “…”
Well, well. His roommate had quite the hidden side.
Later
Ning Guiqu noticed two identical avatars in his WeChat contacts. Feeling uneasy, he tried logging into his alternate account, only to find it completely empty.
Shocked, Ning Guiqu realized with horror: who had he been sending his rants to?
He logged back into his main WeChat account and tentatively sent a message: [Is this account still in use?] 
To his dismay, he received a reply!
[Yes.] 
Ning Guiqu’s vision darkened. He tried to reassure himself that it was fine, totally fine. The person probably didn’t even know him, so it wasn’t embarrassing at all!
A moment later, his phone chimed again.
[Ning Guiqu, you’ve finally realized I’m not your alt account?] 
Ning Guiqu felt like dying. It was someone who knew him!
associated_names: The Cute Roommate Actually Did This Behind My Back!
The Cute Roommate Secretly Did This!

93403.synopsis:
Once celebrated as a war hero, now a guide bearing scars from past injuries, Kang Hajung.
Just a day before his discharge, Hajung is assigned to guide a new recruit, Kim Moohyuk, who has been rushed into the center.
“…If he doesn’t receive guidance, Kim Moohyuk will die.”
Hajung saved him simply because he couldn’t let him die, but in doing so, he found himself irrevocably tied to Moohyuk, an extraordinarily high-ranking Esper unlike any in history.
His long-awaited retirement slips out of reach, and to make matters worse, he’s designated as the pair guide for the much younger Moohyuk. Then, one day, he’s sent on a mission and meets his end, shot dead.
With a regretful thought of not making it to retirement before his death, he opens his eyes to an unfamiliar reflection—a stranger holding his own cheek, in complete shock.
Thus, Hajung awakens in someone else’s body, five years later, in the center. He soon learns that his original body has already been laid to rest.
Despite the chaos, Hajung quickly revives his long-deferred dream of retirement…
“At this point, I’m getting discharged before anyone finds out.”
The relentless struggle of a guide who dreams only of retiring.

94683.synopsis:
Watanabe Fuka is the president of the gardening club. She may not stand out in class, but she’s a kind girl with an enchanting smile.  
“I like you. I like you, Watanabe-san!”  
“Actually, I… I like you too…”  
And so, the troubled high school student, Oki Yukito, thought his youth was finally starting to take shape. Just before his first love could be fulfilled, however, her appearance suddenly changes. The person who appears before him is an Elf!?  
“Did you, by any chance, see it…?”  
Watanabe Fuka is… apparently an elf. A cursed girl from the San-Alfa tribe who fled from the other world, Nache Rivira, to modern-day Tokyo for a certain reason.  
Uh, actually, I’ve… always been interested in you, Oki-kun. With a name like ‘big tree’ and Yukito… it kind of reminds me of Yggdrasil!
“Can I start my confession over!? ”  
Thus, Oki Yukito finds himself swept into a slightly mysterious life in modern-day Japan with the “Elf Watanabe” and becomes embroiled in a grand spectacle revolving around the fate of the other world.
New Light Novel by “The Devil is a Part-Timer” Author Wagahara Satoshi

95707.synopsis:
He is the darkness that permeates the abyss, the twisted shadow slumbering beneath the sea, the destroyer of vast universes, and the most malevolent existence in the world.
And you are the light that penetrates the abyss, the star reflected in the deep ocean, the branch sprouting from the mire, the only antidote, and the hope of the world.
Please, [Save Him] .
But be cautious—protect yourself, and never let Him consume you
Pairings Across Worlds:
A walking human first-aid kit × A ghost haunting the icy tundra
The last human in a wasteland × A savior descending from the heavens
A forgotten artificial intelligence × The lone enforcer in a dying industrial base
The will of a planet × An exile stranded on an abandoned star
An ancient evil god slumbering in the abyss × A meticulously chosen sacrifice
A s*ave purchased from the gladiator arena × A fallen noble lord
A gloomy vampire × A human blood servant

In countless bizarre and fantastical dreams, He extends His mutated limbs, threatening to pull you into an endless mire of thick darkness. You struggle desperately, yet within His alien, icy, blood-red gaze, you see an overwhelming, chaotic depth of love.
[Have you seen the truth?] 
[…I’ll wait for you in the next dream.]
associated_names: 必须拯救邪神之子[快穿]

96475.synopsis: I’ve been reincarnated as the younger brother of the villainess in a romance fantasy otome game my sister used to love. If things continue down this path, only bad endings await. Before my in-game sister falls for the original male lead, I’ve decided to make her fall for me instead.

98523.synopsis:
The 31-year-old veteran Li Nan received two injections of painkillers and fought tooth and nail to get back on China’s ice rink.
Unfortunately, he narrowly missed the podium by just one point.
His career came to an end with a fourth-place finish, marking the conclusion of his professional journey.
The day before announcing his retirement, Li Nan was suffering from a hangover.
As a result, when he closed his eyes and opened them again…
He found himself back in the summer when he was 10 years old.
Bewildered, he only heard a sound by his ear—
【Ding—Superstar System Binding Successful.】
Li Nan: ?
He opened the system’s store and, seeing items like 【Rapid Recovery Potion】 and 【50% Injury Immunity Buff】, his eyes lit up.
Why aim to be a superstar in the entertainment industry when bringing glory to the country is so much sweeter?
He was determined to become a super star on the ice!
…
The First Day of System Binding with Li Nan
【Sign in at the designated location to receive — Acting Training Room in The Sims】
【Quickly use the Acting Training Room to hone your skills and become an Oscar-winning actor, reaching the peak of your life!】
Li Nan glanced at the mission description, then chose to enter the Acting Training Room and selected the simulation target — the famous figure skating champion.
With the system’s help, he immersed himself in a few currently difficult-to-achieve 3As.
System: ?
…
The Nth Day of System Binding with Li Nan
【Host, please complete the cannon fodder slap-in-the-face mission immediately】
【Conquer everyone with your incredibly captivating dance! You are the strongest idol in the industry!】
The next moment, Li Nan performed a graceful forward bend transition into a Belman spin on the ice, holding the skate blade with one hand, creating a beautiful teardrop shape.
Onlookers: “What the hell?”
【Mission determined to be successful】
System: ?
…
Years later, when Li Nan once again stood on the championship podium, people cheered, waved at him in respect, and countless dolls rained down, landing at his feet.
Some said he was the king of the ice, a spirit born specifically for figure skating.
Only Li Nan knew that behind all the glory were sweat and tears, countless sleepless nights that he had traded for this moment.
Of course, it also wouldn’t have been possible without the help of a certain ‘enthusiastic’ system.
System: … (garbled text)
“I will write my youth into the most legendary symphony.”
…

One sentence introduction: Figure skating veteran returns to youth and emerges as butterfly
Concept: Let’s move towards the future together. I will compose my youth into the  most legendary movement.

100827.synopsis:
Franz, hailed as a once-in-a-century prodigy, was a brilliant mind and a master of both swordsmanship and magic. By the age of 18, he had risen to the prestigious position of commander of the Imperial Knights. However, what Franz truly admired was the life of an adventurer. He read novels about adventurers’ exploits and harbored a faint dream of one day leading such a life himself.
After contributing significantly to the Empire’s complete victory in the recent war, Franz was granted a reward of his choice. His request? A long vacation.
Thus, the Empire’s strongest knight found himself with the freedom he had long desired. Registering as a rookie adventurer, Franz set out to travel the nation and live the life he had always dreamed of.
Franz’s journey led him to resolve one issue after another, addressing the problems that plagued the country. In later years, his travels would be remembered as the catalyst for the Empire’s great leap forward. But for Franz himself, he was simply enjoying his long-cherished dream of being an adventurer to the fullest.
This is the story of Franz’s adventures.
associated_names: The Supreme Knight Who Longed for Adventure
帝国最強の天才騎士、冒険者に憧れる

101083.synopsis:
Who would believe it if someone claimed a cat could talk?
“Isn’t my favorite character just too pitiful? He gave everything, but being the second lead, he could never be with the main character—ugh.”
It had been nothing more than a passing lament directed at the stray cat she had been feeding and giving treats to.
[As a token of gratitude for the kind human who gave me delicious food, I’ll grant you a wish, meow! Quickly, tell me what it is!] 
“What wish?”
[You know, what you were mumbling about your favorite character earlier—] 
“Oh, that… If it were me, This is probably how it would have gone. Something like…!”
[Alright, I’ll grant it, meow!] 
She woke up, reincarnated into the novel where her favorite character existed—ten years after its conclusion!
Now that it’s come to this, she’s determined to live happily ever after with her favorite character!
But will she be able to reach a happy ending?

101851.synopsis:
[Dual Male Leads, Husband-Chasing Crematorium, No Male Lead Change, Entertainment Industry, No Female Lead] 
Jiang Su was once a top star, but retired for Huo Qingyan.
For two years, Huo Qingyan treated him with disdain.
Jiang Su, heartbroken, announced his comeback, changing his previous low-key style; he raced cars, drank, took endorsements, appeared on variety shows, and lived it up.
Huo Qingyan couldn’t sit still anymore and proactively approached him: “When are you coming back?”
Jiang Su: “Go home and wash…” (The sentence is cut off, implying he needs to clean himself up before even considering it)
associated_names: 死心后，豪门前任跪求我回头

102107.synopsis:
Jiang Yanxi was a coward before his rebirth.
The only time he was not a coward was when he ran away with his child.
Jiang Yanxi was still a coward after his rebirth. The only time he was not a coward was when he married the father of his child.
Everyone said that Mr. Fu was cold and indifferent, and he probably would never meet someone he liked in this life.
But who knew that Mr. Fu not only got married but also had a child, and he smiled happily like a dog all day long.
The cowardly and flirtatious young master shou VS the pretentious and s*upid gong known as Mr. Fu Erye*.
*Second Master

102363.synopsis:
The beautiful Su Rui transmigrated into a period novel and suddenly recalled the tragic fate of the original owner—forced into a faraway marriage in a poor mountainous region and tormented until her death.
As a female supporting character doomed to be plagued by troublesome suitors, Su Rui refused to be cannon fodder. Having survived until now, she had only two wishes:
Marry a live-in husband.
Become the most capable woman in Xiaoba Village.
To avoid being married off to the infamous village madman by her stepmother, she temporarily kept a low profile and tactfully agreed to her stepsister’s suggestion—an arranged meeting with a pen pal.
But what kind of good man could her stepsister introduce?
A labor reform convict!
While others found love online, she embarked on a disastrous romance.
When he talked about astronomy and geography, she spouted nonsense.
When he spoke of love and devotion, she declared herself cold-hearted.
With bold and reckless moves, she tried everything to make him break up with her.
Yet, despite her constant perfunctory responses and repeated provocations, he never let go?
In the end, she finally found an excuse to dump him and felt utterly relieved.
From then on, she focused on her grand plans—patrolling the mountains, catching spies, beating up hooligans, leading women’s strikes, and hanging rotten suitors upside down for a whipping with chili oil-dipped ropes…
Until one day, a military vehicle arrived.
A high-ranking officer stepped down, dressed in a crisp military uniform, his strikingly handsome face composed, and his phoenix eyes gazing deeply at her… as if she were a heartless little scoundrel.
Su Rui: Why is the male lead here?!
Wait, what’s with that look in his eyes?!
–
Fang Chiye had always been emotionally detached, repeatedly refusing the organization’s matchmaking efforts. From birth to sixty years old, he remained a lifelong bachelor. As a major character in the period novel, he had never been romantically involved with any woman.
The day he saw that bright and lively photograph, he felt absolutely nothing.
Fang Chiye: A misdelivered letter? This must be an enemy spy’s honey trap.
A few days later: Reply and see what trick she’s playing.
A few months later: Dump me? She dumped me?!
Half a year later: I must marry her home!
But… why did she look like she wanted nothing to do with him?
associated_names: 大美人错嫁当军嫂[七零]

103131.synopsis:
Han Yuhyeon, a violinist with demonic talent, made history as the youngest winner of the Queen Elizabeth International Competition.
But in a single tragic moment, an accident took away both his hearing and his dream.
One day, by sheer coincidence, he logs into the virtual reality game Wonderland.
And then…
“I can hear sounds here?”
The genius who had vanished from the world makes his return.
Ding!
[ You have granted a buff through a special performance. ] 
[ You are the first player to grant a buff without using a skill! ] 
Not just any skill—one with overwhelming effects.
“If it’s here, I can chase my dream again.”
Thus begins Han Yuhyeon’s healing life in the world of gaming.

106203.synopsis:
I regressed because I was sick to death of their clinginess. 
I vowed not to even speak to those b*tches this time around. 
But… something about them seems different…

106715.synopsis: “From now on, I am your god.” With overwhelming hypnosis skills, he transfers to another world!

107483.synopsis:
Li Rui had lived to to seventy without any cheat or golden finger. Looking back on his life, he had gained nothing and accomplished nothing. Just as he’s been worn down by the years and resigned to his fate, he unexpectedly awakened the Perfect Life System.
“Come on, tell me, how is a seventy-year-old man who’s about to kick the bucket supposed to live a perfect life?!”
【You are born with the Martial Bone, and from the moment of your birth, you are destined to become the world’s number one. You gain the talent – Martial Bone.】
【At the age of ten, you join a renowned sect and shine in the sect’s grand tournament, gaining fame and attracting the attention of an immortal teacher. You acquire the talent – Divine Skill Mastery.】
Looking at 【Gains the favor of an immortal maiden, becoming a divine couple】, he fell silent.
“Seventy years old is just the right age to start doing things!”
…
Many years later.
Li Rui finally emerges with the supreme innate Dao fetus, slaying ten thousand demons, breaking ten thousand evils, and ruling over the immortal realm for a hundred thousand years. He is hailed by the world as the Evergreen Immortal Venerable.

108251.synopsis:
Yoon Seo’on, the youngest son of the powerful Yoon-o Group, enters into an arranged marriage with CH Group’s executive director, Cha Dokwon, in accordance with his grandfather’s will.
“I’m just asking, Mr. Yoon Seo’on—are you okay with going through with this marriage?”
“I am. I didn’t expect it to happen so soon, but I always figured I’d have to when the time came.”
In the world he grew up in, arranged marriages are common—his own parents married that way—so Seo’on has no particular resistance to the idea.
“Since we’re getting married, I’ll do my best to make you happy, Executive Director.”
There’s some unease, naturally, since Dokwon isn’t from the same subspecies—Seo’on’s a canine-type, and Dokwon is feline. But now that they’re married, he’s determined to make it work.
The real problem?
The man is too kind.
Before Seo’on even realizes it, his heart is swept away by Dokwon’s gentle nature. And once he becomes aware of his feelings—he dives straight in, no hesitation.
“You’re the one who insisted we include a no-dating clause in the premarital contract, Mr. Yoon.”
But Cha Dokwon? He doesn’t seem the least bit inclined to fall for him…

111067.synopsis:
In a world where appearances are everything, two men from opposite sides of wealth collide.
Mu Yuan is a sharp-tongued troublemaker who never knew when to back down. He picked the wrong fight with Wen Shang, a rich heir with too much money and an even nastier temper.
One reckless move led to a brutal payback, and from that moment, neither of them could let it go.
One was hellbent on destroying the other.
The other was determined to grind him into the dirt.
CP:
Cold-Blooded Heir top × Sharp-Tongued Punk bottom.

111579.synopsis:
Xu Yunfan opened his eyes—and in the next instant, found himself a s*ave laboring in the mines beneath the Mine Overseer’s Office.
Armed with a Proficiency Panel that allows him to master any skill in the world, he charges forward through the twilight of a crumbling dynasty, where warlords carve up the land and demons begin to stir.
From honing his body with the “Crimson Tempered Copper Body Technique,” to attaining indestructibility with the “Vajra Suppression Sutra”;
From dashing like the wind with “Fleetfoot Steps,” to treading the air itself with “Glimmering Shadow Glide”;
From spitting arrows of qi with “Tiger-Panther Thunder Roar,” to scorching mountains and boiling seas with the “Golden Crow Radiance Art”!
Rising from nothing, his momentum unstoppable, until at last, with no rivals left, he looks back on the path he’s carved.
“In the end, I beheld the dawn’s wheel unfurling across the boundless sky, steering the long wind over rivers clear for ten thousand miles.”
associated_names: Starting My Immortal Journey by Grinding Proficiency
从肝熟练度开始长生不死

117723.synopsis:
At Qingcheng No. 1 High School, there are two famous figures: one named Song Man, the other Chu Fengqiu.
Song Man is the tyrant of the regular class—a delinquent who skips class, ranks last, and is known as a world-shaking female demon.
Chu Fengqiu is the top student of the advanced class—a goddess with excellent grades, a beautiful appearance, and proficiency in both violin and piano.
Their paths were never meant to cross, until one day, Chu Fengqiu witnessed Song Man casually solve a highly difficult Olympiad math problem with complex steps—a problem that had taken Chu Fengqiu ten minutes just to think through.
Chu Fengqiu: ???
There’s definitely more to this female classmate than meets the eye!
And so, major news broke out at Qingcheng No. 1 High: the goddess of the advanced class was relentlessly pursuing the female demon king!
Shocking! The top student and the slacker met up in the woods… to do their ‘Five-Three’ practice workbooks!

118747.synopsis:
Wen Chi was getting ready to join a romance reality show. His randomly assigned partner? Jiang Siheng—the movie emperor who debuted at the top of the industry.
His manager cheerfully broke the news to him. Wen Chi’s reaction was to collapse on the couch with a deadpan face: “So thrilled.”
A few seconds later, his phone’s robotic voice chimed in: “Damn, time to work again :)”
Thinking of the breach-of-contract penalty, Wen Chi slung on his little backpack and tearfully left home to brave the journey ahead.
The other contestants on the show? Internet-famous starlets more popular than him, filthy rich CEOs, game streamers with more fans…
No way to win. So whatever.
Wen Chi lies down in peace.jpg
While everyone else showed up dressed like flamboyant peacocks, Wen Chi rocked a loose T-shirt, oversized shorts, slippers, and a mini water bottle hanging around his neck—he looked exactly like a kindergartener on a class trip.
At first, the producers were worried Jiang Siheng wouldn’t be interested in Wen Chi, and that the two might lack chemistry on screen. But they quickly realized they’d overthought it.
During game segments, other couples worked together to complete tasks. As for the HengWen1 CP, Jiang Siheng did every single task himself under the blazing sun, while Wen Chi sat comfortably in the shade, wearing a bucket hat while hugging his water bottle, gently patting his hands to cheer Jiang Siheng on.
New viewers: Why is Wen Chi just sitting under the tree doing nothing? I can’t with this. Poor Jiang Siheng.
Viewers who watched the entire stream: It’s not that Wen Chi won’t move—it’s that Jiang Siheng absolutely refuses to let him get even a little sun.
Jiang Siheng spoiled Wen Chi so much, it made everyone else look away… but honestly, it was so good to ship!!
After the show ended, fans thought that was it for the HengWen CP, and cried their eyes out.
Until one day, during a red carpet livestream, Jiang Siheng’s nanny van pulled up outside. Fans who’d been waiting forever excitedly turned to look.
The man got out—but instead of heading towards the red carpet, he leaned slightly into the van and started talking to someone inside.
Fans wondered who it could be—who could get Jiang Siheng to speak so gently?
Then, a familiar salted fish slowly shuffled out of the van—none other than Wen Chi, obediently holding Jiang Siheng’s hand.
The closest fans overheard their conversation.
“Jiang Siheng, I’m so tired…”
“There, there. We’ll go home right after we get the award.”
“This is all your fault. I told you not to do it so many times. My back is killing me.”
“Mm, I won’t next time. You were amazing, baby.”
Fans: …Is there something going on here that we’re not supposed to know about?
*1 = translates to Constant Temperature so i thought of keeping it as the transliteration
associated_names: 咸鱼在恋爱综艺摆烂[娱乐圈]

120027.synopsis: I’m just an ordinary guy who likes to flirt.

122843.synopsis:
Humanity was forced into a brutal world that operated like a sailing survival game.
Lin Yuan had struggled in the game for five years, only to be betrayed by his female first mate.
But after his death, he was reborn—back to the moment before the game began.
Having seen the female first mate’s true colors, Lin Yuan swore he would never be a simp again.
Using his deep understanding of the game, he set himself up with a god-tier starting hand:
He awakened the game’s only hidden god-tier talent: “King of the Sea.”
Then he soul-bonded with a sovereign-level sea monster, the Kraken, gaining growth feedback.
Instead of sticking with the campus belle-turned-first mate, he recruited Yan Yingli, the future Pirate Empress.
Just like her, all the crew members he gathered were destined to become the best in their fields:
He Letian — the future number one ship doctor in the game.
Sun Hao — the future number one ship chef.
Shen Tian — the future number one navigator.
Xia Yuanzhou — the future number one gunner.
Lin Yuan made sure the woman who once got him killed paid the price she deserved.
Then, he set his sights on the boundless sea.
He vowed to become the ruler of all the seas!
Leading his crew toward legend and immortality!
associated_names: 全民大航海：拒绝校花，招揽女帝

123355.synopsis:
Half a year ago, S-class Esper Kang Juha, who had gone missing during the Sonora Operation, returned in tatters.
And S-class psychic-type ability user Seong Ihyeon received orders to treat him.
“I’m Seong Ihyeon, Information Team Leader of the Information Security Division, National Security Bureau of the Center.”
Kang Juha, who had been brainwashed by anti-alliance forces, showed the behavior of a wild beast.
Even so, after putting in effort for several days and nights, he had barely managed to make him human-like again……
“Are you a doctor? Did I get hospitalized because I’m sick?”
Something was strange about his condition.
The guy who was praised as the pride of Korea’s Center and called an Alpha was speaking with the innocent language of a young child.

127451.synopsis:
Jiang Shi had both brains and beauty, and on top of that, a fiery temper to match.
After living more than ten years in luxury as a pampered young master, he finally caught up with a popular novel cliché—the fake vs. real young master trope.
And yes… he was the fake one.
But there was no scheming fake son acting like a green tea b*tch, no dramatic comeback of the real son slapping faces. The exchange went peacefully on both sides.
Jiang Shi followed his biological mother through twists and turns, and at last… ended up in the poor and remote Xiliu Village.
Looking around, Jiang Shi instantly felt like the sky had collapsed.
…
The spoiled little master found everything dissatisfying, and his frustration reached its peak when, after bumping into a village boy, he managed to sprain his own ankle.
Sitting on the ground, brows furrowed, he dumped all the blame onto the other.
“Seriously, are you sick or something? Why’d you bump into me out of nowhere?”
Cheng Ye also thought there must be something wrong with him. He stared at Jiang Shi’s face, not even knowing what to do with his own hands.
He had never seen anyone so beautiful before. Every part of him was flawless—skin pale and glowing, lips moving as if his words carried a fragrance that unsettled Cheng Ye’s very soul.
Selfishly, Cheng Ye reached out to touch that delicate, porcelain-white ankle, his voice hoarse as he said:
“Sorry.”
If not for his own strong build, Jiang Shi wouldn’t have twisted his foot.
So Jiang Shi simply leaned into the situation, letting Cheng Ye wait on him. The other boy stayed silent, hardworking, perfectly embodying the phrase an honest man who doesn’t talk much.
Jiang Shi couldn’t help envying Cheng Ye’s well-toned muscles. Seeing how he had no one to rely on, Jiang Shi got an idea.
“Hey! How about this—I’ll pay for your schooling, and you’ll be my little brother. Deal?”
And just like that, Jiang Shi bought Cheng Ye’s entire life with a mere few tens of thousands of yuan.
When Cheng Ye was still a penniless farm boy, he served Jiang Shi the best food and drink.
When Cheng Ye began making his way in the world, constantly busy, he still made sure Jiang Shi had the best food and drink.
And when Cheng Ye finally became a business tycoon… Jiang Shi didn’t even need to lift a finger to eat or drink.
All the people who once looked down on Jiang Shi, waiting to see him make a fool of himself, waited and waited. But in the end, they realized—he was living even better than he had back in the Jiang family.
…
Wait. Did he save the universe in his past life or something?

128219.synopsis:
She was the bird that wandered through his sky, he was the lonely island in her life
“As long as I’m with you, you don’t have to be afraid of anything.”
One sentence, like a spell, gripped the hearts of two people, and sealed the fate of three.
Zhi An, dazzling like a blazing fire. Zhi Yi, gentle like still water. And Ji Ting, caught between fire and water, let down the gentleness of water, yet couldn’t quite reach the flames.
Maybe she actually could be touched. Only, she burned too fiercely. So most of the time, she could only be seen from afar. If he recklessly ignored everything, wouldn’t that fire end up burning more than just himself?
“Is it that you don’t want to, don’t dare, or… can’t?”
“You know what, Ji Ting? I look down on you.”
For the sake of revenge, and perhaps because she was simply too tired, Zhi An chose to walk away. But the farther she ran, the deeper her unease grew.
Like a nightbird that keeps flying and flying and flying, the island in her heart was still there… but she didn’t dare land.
Only then did she realize, she had been rushing forward, too afraid to look back. Because if she did, if she turned around all of a sudden, maybe she’d never be able to find that boy again.

130011.synopsis:
After dying in a car accident, Seo-woo possesses the body of Stella, the villainous “fake saintess” from a novel. She expected to live a blessed life, revered as a saintess and engaged to the crown prince.
But reality was far from her expectations. Her life turned into an exhausting routine of waking at dawn and praying endlessly, trapped in a grueling work environment.
“Look! The real saintess has appeared!”
One day, the true saintess, Diane, suddenly arrived at the imperial palace. With her arrival, Stella’s engagement to the crown prince was annulled, and she was demoted to the humiliating role of the saintess’s servant.
Seriously, isn’t this too much?
When a saintess harbors resentment, frost falls even in midsummer.
Determined to take revenge on the new saintess and the imperial family that abandoned her, Stella devises a cunning plan.
“Ugh…”
“Hah, I’ve received your seed well.”
Her goal? To steal the crown prince, Theodore’s, purity!
After shaming the imperial palace with her actions, Stella escapes, leaving Theodore in chaos. Obsessed, he begins a desperate search to find her.
“A-ah… Hngh! S-slow down!”
“I was curious… Why does my lower body only react to you?”
But is Theodore chasing her purely for revenge? Or is there something else driving his obsession? Could it be… something more?
associated_names: 나를 버린 약혼자에게 복수하려 했을 뿐인데

145627.synopsis:
Lin Leyou had been trapped by his family his entire life. Right after graduating from high school, he was forced to start working to support them, all because he had just gained a younger brother. Whenever he showed the slightest reluctance, his parents would use family affection to guilt and bind him.
And so, he became a beast of burden for this family for nearly thirty years. By the time he was almost fifty, he had no house, no car, no savings, no wife, and no children. Even the so-called family affection turned out to be fake. In the end, his death was just as inexplicable.
He never expected that when he opened his eyes again, he would return to the time right after graduating from high school and become a permanent NPC in an infinite world!
associated_names: 重生后成为了无限世界的常驻NPC

147163.synopsis:
“You said you liked me. Was that… all a lie?”
“How could an Alpha like a Beta?”
Between a mother who abandoned him and a father who forced him to live as an Alpha, Alex grew up without ever leaning on anyone.
The only one who comforted him, regardless of his secondary gender, was Nathan.
To protect Nathan from a certain incident, Alex pushes him away with cruel words.
Years pass, nine long years of penance and longing.
Then one day, they reunite at the scene of a case where Nathan is the witness.
“Mr. Nathan, if it’s alright or rather, if you don’t mind there’s something I’d like to say…”
“If you’re thinking of apologizing, don’t bother.”
Alex hovers anxiously around Nathan, desperate to apologize, but Nathan coldly keeps things strictly professional.
Then, due to side effects from long-term suppressant use, Alex’s hormonal imbalance is exposed.
“You could just sleep with an Omega. Why are you looking for something else? You like Omegas.”
